subject.title: feat(apple): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: Should OpenClaw ship native iOS/macOS transcript-widget image export as a maintained companion-app feature once its filename and real-device proof gates are satisfied?
rationale: This is a new user-facing native interaction, and the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit maintainer choice beyond ordinary code correctness.

options.title: Sponsor with proof and repair
options.body: Keep the feature direction, require the filename bound and redacted signed-app copy/save evidence before merge.

options.title: Defer the native export surface
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers do not want transcript-widget export to become a supported Apple companion-app interaction now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with proof and repair
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, require the filename bound and redacted signed-app copy/save evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed Apple implementation and the matching cross-platform workstream, making them the clearest available technical routing candidate.
